assumptions: Fresh effective settings includes classic protection and applicable inherited rulesets; authority is not a static mirror

Authority reads require admin-level access: classic PAT with repo scope, Administration:read, or GitHub App with administration permission; contents:read is NOT sufficient (live run 36186790619 proved github.token gets Resource not accessible by integration)
secrets.SYNC_TOKEN (classic PAT with repo scope) is wired as AUTHORITY_TOKEN for authority-read steps only; github.token is kept for everything else
probeAuthorityReadPermissions requires non-null branchProtectionRule or the documented REST /protection null-distinction, aligned with the gather
tokenScopedRead swaps GH_TOKEN to AUTHORITY_TOKEN for authority reads only and restores it immediately
Issue 3571 supplies AUTHORITY_TOKEN from main workflow YAML before this PR merges. Its code uses live authority only and refuses if that token or settings are unreadable.
goal: Establish live effective required-check authority without stale snapshots or advisory vetoes; prove token permissions at preflight after the guarded workflow token bootstrap in issue 3571 lands.
prohibited_actions: do not change required_status_checks.strict; it is false by owner ruling in issue #1286
do not touch any migration or database object
do not edit another session handoff, worktree, branch, or claim
stop_conditions: Refuse authorization if live settings are unreadable; do not broaden credentials
Do not mutate settings without exact independent approval
